name: Work Breakdown Structure
purpose: Decomposes all the work of the project, starting at the project level and breaking it down into finer levels of detail. The lowest level is the work package, a discrete deliverable that can be decomposed into activities. The approved WBS, its WBS dictionary and the project scope statement together make up the scope baseline.

elements.guidance: The point where scope, schedule and cost are integrated and used to measure project performance.
The lowest-level deliverable in the WBS, used to estimate and measure resources, cost and duration. Each work package rolls up to one and only one control account for reporting.

tailoring: The needs of the project decide how the WBS is organized; the second level sets the organization. Options the book names: geography, major deliverables, life cycle phases, subprojects.
For smaller projects, draw the WBS like an organizational chart, with deliverables in boxes and subordinate deliverables beneath.
For larger projects, arrange the WBS as an outline with a numbering structure.
At the start only two or three levels may be defined; progressive elaboration then decomposes the work into finer deliverables.
If the organization has accounting codes, align each deliverable to a specific accounting code to track expenditure.

citation: Book of Forms form 2.9, PDF pages 60 to 61 (printed pages 49 to 50); blank form PDF page 62 (printed page 51)
notes: Table 2.9 (PDF page 61, printed page 50) defines only Control account and Work package. The blank form is an indented numbered outline whose lines are placeholders (Project, Major Deliverable, Control Account, Work Package), per references/fields/2.9.json. Uncertain point: Table 2.9 says each work package rolls up to one and only one control account, but the printed sample puts some work packages directly under a major deliverable (the line numbered 1.1.2 sits beside the control account 1.1.1) and a control account at level 2 (1.2); the book does not reconcile this, so do not derive a rule from the sample. The book also does not state how many levels a WBS should have. The high levels are defined at the start; lower levels may be progressively elaborated (PDF page 60, printed page 49).
